name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump says the U.S. will collect tolls and impose blockade in the Strait of Hormuz, man killed by federal agents in Maine, states sue to stop Paramount-Warner Bros merger.

changes.title: Trump's National Guard deployment in D.C. has been extended until 2029
changes.summary: President Trump's deployment of the National Guard to Washington, D.C., has been extended several times. Now it's set to last until Inauguration Day 2029. (Image credit: Kevin Dietsch).

changes.title: How a Promising Navy Drone Boat Program Got Mired in Politics
changes.summary: Navy acquisition reforms upended a $2.1 billion contract competition. When it was over, several companies with ties to the Trump administration had made the cut.

changes.title: Can Democrats Win Rural Voters Turning Away From Trump? It’s a Tough Sell.
changes.summary: House candidates like Beth Macy, author of “Dopesick,” have crafted messages based on lifetimes in rural regions. But messages need an audience, and many minds are closed to the party.

changes.title: Trump says he doesn't see a lot of "evil" in Lindsey Graham's death when asked about FBI probe
changes.summary: President Trump took questions in the Oval Office and commented on an apparent FBI probe into Lindsey Graham's death, saying he doesn't see a lot of "evil" behind the sudden incident.

changes.title: Shippers say Strait of Hormuz fee would open "dangerous Pandora's Box"
changes.summary: Industry insiders say "there is no legal basis" for Trump to impose a 20% fee on cargo transiting the Strait of Hormuz, something he now says he's decided not to do.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: President Donald Trump on Tuesday announced a reversal of plans to charge a 20% toll on cargo going through the Strait of Hormuz, saying that Middle Eastern countries will instead make investment and trade deals with the U.S.

changes.title: E. Jean Carroll Receives $5.6 Million Payment From Trump in Civil Case
changes.summary: A federal jury found President Trump liable for sexually abusing and defaming Ms. Carroll. He exhausted his appeals last month, prompting a judge to order that the money be paid.

changes.title: ‘I Am Frustrated’: Emails Show Blanche’s Role in Trump’s Retribution Campaign
changes.summary: The cooperation of Todd Blanche will be a flashpoint in his confirmation hearing to be attorney general on Wednesday.

changes.title: Trump administration orders ICE to suspend most vehicle stops after deadly shootings
changes.summary: The suspension is not absolute and there's room for exceptions when executing a criminal warrant or working with partner agencies.
